name: - FDP
fix_description: Exclude the LP pair from reflections (add to _isExcluded). Currently the pair is not excluded, so its balanceOf is computed via _rOwned/rate. When deliver() reduces _rTotal, the rate decreases and the pair balance inflates, enabling arbitrage. Excluding the pair makes its balance use _tOwned which is unaffected by rate changes.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack involving a flash loan, swapping into a reflective fee-on-transfer token, abusing the token’s `deliver()` mechanics to distort the pair’s effective balances, and then draining value via the AMM pair swap. It is not a generic bug pattern and requires understanding reflective token accounting plus UniswapV2-style pair behavior, but the PoC itself is still fairly short and contained.
